It's the nearest one unless you want to go about an hour to Round1 at Saga, and we all know that's a pretty far distance especially with Japanese toll fees. Plus, they appear to update all of their games (not including DDR) so it's a pretty nice place to play. / All machines look great and play fairly well. Guaranteed they're not the best, you can still rack up pretty nice scores assuming you adapt to the machine. Please check the cabinets section for more. I vaguely remember the cabinets as I didn't spend too much time there, but they had lots of music games. / I'll update this with more info as soon as I can.

Enter the bar and walk towards the far back, past the pool tables to find the arcade area. / Due to regulations on alcohol, players under 18 are only allowed to stay until 8 PM in the company of their parents. At Fridays and Saturdays you may have to be 20 and above to enter, sometimes you may need to show your valid ID (screenshots are not accepted) - but it's worth talking to the staff to see if they can make an exception. / The arcade uses its own coins, which can be purchased at these rates: / - 7 Tokens for 100 SEK with Card Payment / - 15 Tokens for 200 SEK with Card Payment. / There are exchange machines are besides the bar and in the arcade area. / As of October 13, 2025, the cash exchange machines are no longer there. / Every Monday 21:00 (22:00 in Summer), there will be half off discounts on for BEMANI games with paseli support. This lasts for 24hrs. / For paseli/petals codes, you have to buy them from the HEY Sthlm website. arcades.info_text: Pixel Arcade is an hobbyist run arcade and pinball hall in Malmö. A modern take on the classic arcades of the 1980s, blending elements from the arcades of the 80s and 90s, Japanese rhythm games, and a passion for preserving gaming culture. / Social gaming and the retro arcade experience — now rare to find — are at the heart of what Pixel Arcade stands for. / Admission: / Adults: 175 SEK / Youth (ages 7–15): 125 SEK / Minimum age to visit alone: 16 years. / Children under 16 are welcome when accompanied by a paying adult.
